turns.question: What was our cart abandonment rate between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no cart abandonment rate metric, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are the cart-to-checkout rate (share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on that day or the day after), cart sessions and checkout sessions, which I can report for 20 September to 3 October 2026 if you like.
